title: Where does each request belong?
prompt: Place each request where it will get the right answer.

pairs.item: How do other admins structure an agent rollout for new teams?
pairs.why: Questions and best practices belong in the community, where many peers can answer.

pairs.item: Our connector shows a sync error for every user since this morning.
pairs.why: Bugs and errors in a Glean instance go to a support ticket.

pairs.item: We would like a new setting that the product does not offer today.
pairs.why: Feature requests and product feedback go to the Feedback and Ideas board.

takeaway: Route by the kind of answer you need: shared knowledge, instance resolution, or product input.
